summary: Tested A2G modules frontend integration (Step 2). All 6 modules are properly wired in admin sidebar and routes work correctly. Fixed critical bug in A2GContactDetailPage where contactId was not being passed as prop from AdminLayout. Fixed route ordering in contacts_routes.py (export routes before {contact_id}).

minor.issue: Route ordering bug - export routes were defined AFTER /{contact_id}, causing them to be matched as contact IDs. FIXED by moving export routes before /{contact_id}.

ui_bugs.issue: contactId was not being passed from AdminLayout - useParams() doesn't work when component is rendered directly without React Router Route. FIXED by passing contactId as prop.

critical_code_review_comments: AdminLayout.jsx: Uses path.match() for route detection - must pass extracted IDs as props to child components
contacts_routes.py: Fixed route ordering - static routes (/export, /export/csv, /export/vcf) must be defined BEFORE dynamic routes (/{contact_id})
A2GContactDetailPage.jsx: Now accepts contactId as prop with fallback to useParams() for flexibility
seed_data_creation: Created test task 'Test Task from UI', test event 'Test Event from UI', and test booking during UI testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: A2G modules Step 2 frontend integration complete. All routes working: /admin/tasks (under CRM), /admin/contacts, /admin/contacts/:id, /admin/calendar, /admin/radio, /admin/andgo, /admin/booking, /booking/:slug (public). Sidebar structure verified: CRM accordion contains Tasks, top-level items are Contacts, Calendar, Radio, And...Go, Booking.

bugs_fixed.issue: A2GContactDetailPage was rendered without contactId prop
bugs_fixed.fix: Extract contactId from path and pass as prop: <A2GContactDetailPage contactId={contactId} />

bugs_fixed.issue: Only used useParams() which doesn't work when rendered directly
bugs_fixed.fix: Accept contactId as prop with fallback to useParams()
